chunks: Abu Baṣīr narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
No man refrains from hajj except because of a sin, and what Allah, Mighty and Majestic, pardons is greater.

key_terms.الْحَجِّ: hajj, the pilgrimage to the Sacred House
key_terms.بِذَنْبٍ: because of a sin or sinful state
key_terms.تَخَلَّفَ: held back or refrained from going
key_terms.عَزَّ وَجَلَّ: Mighty and Majestic, an expression of divine exaltation

ai.seo_question: Why does a person neglect hajj according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that neglecting hajj is tied to sin and spiritual deficiency rather than being a trivial matter. At the same time, it emphasizes the vastness of Allah’s forgiveness, combining warning with hope.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2862 - Abu Basir narrated from Abu Abdullah (as), who said:
"No person refrains from performing Hajj except due to a sin, and what Allah (swt), the Exalted, forgives is greater."
